signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.errorUnconfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox for the link we sent when you signed up.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.termsCheckboxLabel: Agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
signUp.errorEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
signUp.errorWeakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.
signUp.errorTermsRequired: Accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to create an account.
signUp.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.intro: Enter the email you use for Sober Helpline. We'll email you a code to choose a new password.
reset.codeIntro: If an account uses {{email}}, a code is on its way. It can take a minute — check spam too.
reset.errorEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
reset.errorTooMany: Several codes were already sent to this address in the last hour. Use the newest code in your email, or request a new one in an hour.
reset.errorSend: We couldn't send the code. Check your connection and try again.
reset.errorCode: That code didn't work or has expired. Check the email or send a new code.
reset.errorPasswordLength: Your new password needs at least 8 characters.
reset.errorSave: We couldn't save your new password. Please try again.
reset.successBody: You're signed in with your new password.
reset.errorSaveSignedIn: Your code worked and you're signed in, but the new password didn't save. To set it, sign out from Settings and use "Forgot password?" again.
